summary: The construction and all constants check out. The parity-class count is correctly bounded by 2^rho via the rank-rho lattice Gamma, the exact minimum-unmatched fractional matching gives the stated mass identity, and the strict atom cap yields 2^(n-rho) M > 51Q/3200. The midpoint-convolution predecessor applies because every source degree is at most a_y/4, and the product-centroid Grunbaum bound correctly upgrades 2 nu <= mu_C to sigma_s <= mu_C, including repeated atoms and degenerate halfspaces. The dominated-measure residual theorem then applies with exactly the ranks rho_s and r_s, producing (24); if r_s=0, gamma_(2d)>1/e and e<3 force D>Q/100, contradicting the hard inequality. Boundary, empty-class, singleton-class, repeated-midpoint, rank-zero, and whole-space cases are all covered.
